name: I Cut Them Off, They Begged(Dubbed)
desc: Sophia Lewis cared for houseguest Lily Miller for a year, only to be betrayed by Lily's twisted diary that ruined her reputation and led to her death. Reborn, Sophia refuses Lily's exploitation, exposes her lies, and strikes back when Lily accuses her again on exam results day.

name: I Write My Own Fate
desc: Emma Lee wakes as the betrayed heroine of an ancient romance novel! Her husband Oliver Smith abandons her to marry another. Refusing to be helpless, she uses wit and courage to rewrite her fate, break women's chains, and navigate love and intrigue, forging her own legendary path.

name: Ashes Burn, She Rises
desc: For six years, Sophia's daughter was forbidden from calling Noah Wright "Daddy," while his first love's son was groomed as heir. After being reborn, she divorces immediately, rebuilds her career to its former glory, and starts a happy life with her daughter—leaving her ex drowning in regret.

name: Stockholm Boys
desc: Under the shadow of a family feud, Axel and Elias wield love as their weapon, teetering on the edge of revenge and redemption, ultimately igniting an unbreakable love forged through shared pain and obsession.

name: No Love, Only Empire
desc: Time-traveler Princess Su Yuci spends ten years building her husband Jiang Chenyuan into a business tycoon and donates her kidney to him. He betrays her with his mistress and illegitimate son at her sister's engagement party. She orchestrates his downfall and returns to her era victorious.

name: My Mafia Pilot Boyfriend
desc: Tony Baker, a debt-ridden flight attendant, unexpectedly matches with Ryan Rossi, his charming but secretive pilot crush, on Grindr. Their whirlwind romance blossoms amidst the high-flying glamour of airline life, but Tony soon discovers Ryan's dark secret: he's the heir to a powerful mafia family, smuggling drugs under the guise of his prestigious career. As Tony unravels Ryan's dangerous double life, their forbidden love story intertwines with a thrilling investigation, forcing them to navigate workplace politics, deadly rivals, and the ever-present threat of exposure. Will their love survive the turbulent skies of their dangerous lives?

name: Dumping the Racing Star
desc: Heiress Camille's marriage to racer Maddox turns tragic when manipulative agent Avery convinces him she is unfaithful, leading to the loss of their child due to his coldness. After their divorce, Camille reclaims her position and teams with her brother Knox to destroy her enemies.

name: I Cut Them Off, They Begged
desc: Sophia Lewis cared for houseguest Lily Miller for a year, only to be betrayed by Lily's twisted diary that ruined her reputation and led to her death. Reborn, Sophia refuses Lily's exploitation, exposes her lies, and strikes back when Lily accuses her again on exam results day.

name: Ruthless Heiress Claims the Throne
desc: Reborn, Sophia Martin becomes ruthless, punishing servants and showing no mercy to her abusive brother Noah Smith. She counters her sister Emma Smith's schemes, exposing her treason. Partnering with War Lord Ethan Miller, they crush the rebellion and ascend the throne as legendary co-rulers.

name: The Scientist He Begged For
desc: After six years in the dark, Sophia Robinson divorces Oliver Clark when she discovers his first love abroad and he disappears during their daughter's crisis. She rises to scientific titan with global acclaim. As she finds new happiness, the once-cold Oliver desperately begs her back.

name: Mafia Princess Kicks Ass on Christmas
desc: Mafia princess Lucia Capello, secretly trained by her grandfather for three years, returns home at Christmas to discover that “Mrs. Capello” is an impostor—her real mother has been humiliated. Alone, Lucia takes on everyone, reclaims her family’s power, and finds love with her quiet protector, Noah.

name: Lap by Lap, Back to You
desc: She gave up everything for his Olympic dream. Years later, champion Justin returns to Brook, now a struggling single mom with his secret child. Can love rewrite their past, or will lies sink them forever?

name: Christmas Awakening: I See Your Countdown
desc: Hotel cleaner Landon is betrayed by his cheating wife, who drains their savings while his mother needs medical help. After a car accident, he gains the ability to see lifespans and object values. He rises to wealth, saves his mother, and wins heiress Quella's heart—while his betrayers pay.

name: Heart Speaks, True Heiress Wins(Dubbed)
desc: Yama's daughter Yan Zhao possesses a young heiress who was framed by the evil impostor Shen Xinrou. Her family overhears her thoughts and uncovers Shen Xinrou and her father's schemes. With her family's support, she becomes a beloved heiress, gaining her in-laws' favor and her husband's love.

name: Villainess Turned Favorite(Dubbed)
desc: Emily becomes the villainess in a novel with three ruthless brothers. On the first day, she offends the male lead, Michael, then meets Thomas in an elevator, bows to him, and sleeps with him. Later, at a birthday banquet, Thomas appears as a feared villain and wealthy heir.

name: Reborn to Love My Baby Daddy
desc: Sophia Lewis learns she's pregnant the day her firefighter husband dies. His diary reveals he has loved her since 2007, before their marriage. Her tears fall on the pages, and she's reborn to the day they met, still pregnant.

name: Trap for His Heart
desc: Mia, after inheriting her grandfather's estate, is locked away by the Wilson family and forced to pretend to be mentally unstable to survive. Seeking revenge, she escapes and targets Daniel, a powerful heir, using her charm and careful plans to win him over step by step.

name: Daddy's Little Healer(Dubbed)
desc: To break the family curse, Noah rescues and adopts Little Ruby. She saves Sebastian from a car crash. When the patriarch falls ill, she heals him—but Emma frames her. In the end, Ruby breaks the curse as Sebastian relentlessly fights dangers to protect her.

name: The Scientist He Begged For(Dubbed)
desc: After six years in the dark, Sophia Robinson divorces Oliver Clark when she discovers his first love abroad and he disappears during their daughter's crisis. She rises to scientific titan with global acclaim. As she finds new happiness, the once-cold Oliver desperately begs her back.

name: Phoenix's Rise to the Throne
desc: Emily, once a failed consort betrayed and killed despite supporting the prince to emperor, is reborn. Determined to avoid past mistakes, she spends ten years mastering dance, charm, and business to gain power, win the prince's heart, and become empress.

name: Billions Per Second
desc: Delivery guy Chen Mo gets a system that earns him massive interest per second, becoming a mega-tycoon overnight. He saves Su Qingxue's company, gets engaged to heiress Qin Wan'er, gifts Su Qingxue a sky full of stars, then flies abroad to secure life-saving drugs for the obsessed Chu Feifei.

name: Revenge at the Imperial Banquet
desc: Emily Wilson was framed and killed by her sister Sarah and fiancé at the Emperor's banquet in her past life. Reborn one day before, she gathers evidence of their affair and conspiracy. At the imperial celebration, she's determined to expose their true faces and seek revenge.

name: The Ninth Divorce
desc: Sophia loved Noah for eight years, but their marriage cycled through divorce and remarriage due to his first love’s interference. After their ninth divorce, she left the country and married Lucas, the wealthy heir, in a marriage of convenience. His gentleness turned their contract into true love.

name: Fresh Scars, Old Wounds(Dubbed)
desc: Shen Xuanyi is protected by his wife Gu Yuezhen, childhood friend Pei Xiangxiang, and sister Shen Leyan. On his 29th birthday, his sister is brutally murdered. His wife defends the killer, while Pei pressures him to forgive. Heartbroken, he dials a mysterious number from his grandma's music box.

name: Making My Fake-Amnesia Wife Regret(Dubbed)
desc: Taylor is betrayed to death by his wife Scarlett and reborn five years earlier. He discovers her amnesia is fake, meant for her first love. He divorces her, leaving empty-handed, and refuses to help when her company faces disaster. Scarlett regrets her actions and suffers the consequences.

name: She Funded His Downfall
desc: Businesswoman Jiang Jinyue returns to save her husband Zhou Chenye's failing company, only to find him with his secretary Cheng Qi, who's using her belongings and her mother's heirlooms. Betrayed, she withdraws her support, exposes the conspiracy, and finds love with her childhood friend An Sheng.

name: Accidentally Married a Sleeping Beauty(Dubbed)
desc: To pay for his parents' medical bills, Ethan Miller agrees to a high-stakes marriage. Although he thought his spouse, Sophia Walker, was nearly forty, she turns out to be a beautiful young woman. Through Ethan‘s care, she recovers, tests his sincerity, and leaves the hospital.

name: From Today, I'm the Richest(Dubbed)
desc: Zhang Chao struggles with debt as a delivery driver, despised for his poverty. Delivering to a wealthy gathering, he's mocked and pushed down, injuring his leg and losing his job. At his lowest, he encounters a life-changing opportunity.

name: The Little Spirit Seer
desc: Six-year-old Su Niannian is saved by tycoon Zhou Yuanchi after drowning. Granted Yin-Yang eyes and a chance to revive, she must collect five sincere tears, using Zhou Yuanchi's unique body to stabilize her soul. Adopted, she uncovers family plots and forms deep bonds, embarking on a warm journey.

name: Mind-Reading Heiress: I Strike Back
desc: Qin Leyan is adopted by the Qin family for her rare blood type to transfuse their sick son, Qin Muchuan. Later, the family finds their biological daughter, Qin Shuyao, who is also a transmigrator. Author Qin Yan transmigrates into the story and begins changing Qin Leyan's fate.

name: Dumped the Liar, Married My Protector
desc: After learning her marriage was a lie, Fiona is reborn, returns to her wealthy family, and marries her childhood prince. Her ex breaks down: "Didn't you say you'd only love me?" Adapted from the Tomato novel The School Hunk Cheated, I Married the Prince, and He Went Crazy.

name: My Taboo Crush on My Stepbrother
desc: Rebellious heir Aiden and spirited Vivian become step-siblings. From rivalry to a passionate entanglement, they navigate forbidden love amid family trauma, societal pressure, and school bullying.

name: The Janitor Swordsman(Dubbed)
desc: In a world where fencing settles disputes, the Sword King Michael dies fighting the Seven Kingdoms. His brother David, who vowed never to wield a sword, breaks his oath to save Emily and Sword Hall. He sacrifices his hand, defeats the Sword Demon with his left, and restores the nation's honor.

name: One Punch for Justice(Dubbed)
desc: Han Chuan, the undefeated boxing king, is drugged and falls from grace. After his daughter's death, he becomes a deliveryman. His landlady's daughter Miao Miao becomes his hope—until she's kidnapped for her rare panda blood. Now, Han Chuan must fight back to save her and crush the gang.

name: Thanksgiving With Mom and Dad
desc: A brave girl fights to save her dying father, unaware that the woman who helps her is the mother she has been searching for her whole life.

name: The Mighty Lady Fixes the Manor
desc: A boxing champ mocks a romance novel online, then wakes up inside it as doomed Princess Sophia—demoted to concubine on her wedding day. Facing disaster, she declares war on scumbags and schemers, then turns to General Asher: "Hang in there—I'm here to save you!"

name: Done With Mr. Wrong
desc: Her movie-star husband, Huo Yan, cheats on their wedding night, drunkenly calling his mistress's name while holding Shen Zhiyi. She exposes them. The Huo family pressures her, but she allies with Huo Yan's rival to crush them. Justice prevails as she finds her own romance and warmth.

name: Cold Beauty Reborn(Dubbed)
desc: Her parents divorced; her mother remarried a tycoon. Her greedy sister followed their mother, while she helped her father and brothers succeed—only to be betrayed and killed. Reborn on the day of the divorce, she watches her sister choose their father and realizes she has also been reincarnated.

name: Noble Wife, Raising Her Revenge(Dubbed)
desc: Sophia Walker, once the marquis household matriarch, was poisoned after adopting a concubine's children. Reborn, she takes revenge—demotes the daughter originally intended as heir, arranges the eldest daughter to serve in the Prince Frost's Residence, and reclaims her power and status.

name: Mistaken Surrogacy, Christmas Destiny
desc: She gave everything for love, only to be betrayed while pregnant. Four months along, Rose is cast out by her cheating husband. But the baby belongs to Brad, a magnetic billionaire. Rose and Brad strike a deal: a flash marriage, shared revenge. Fighting side by side, vengeance turns into tender love.

name: An Unexpected CEO Wife
desc: Rural athlete Jiang Feng goes to the city for his mother's surgery, saves Shen Group's chairman, and is urged to marry his granddaughter, CEO Shen Rong. She doubts his motives but sees his integrity in their secret marriage. As rivals scheme, she defends him, and love takes root.

name: Dumped, Then Married an Ice Queen
desc: Doctor Lin Fan is betrayed at his wedding by his date Ye Shuqi and his brother Lin Yi. He hastily marries Wei Zhihan, also jilted, believing her poor and vowing to provide for her. Unknown to him, she's Wei Group's heiress who secretly protects him from his family's schemes as they fall in love.

name: Passed Probation, Pregnant by My Boss
desc: Lin Xi, from a rural family, earns admission to a top university but faces workplace obstruction. After a one-night stand with Huo Zhiheng, she gains permanent status but feels guilt-ridden. Avoiding him fails as their bond deepens. When she becomes pregnant, he brings her home and dotes on her.

name: Fresh Scars, Old Wounds
desc: Shen Xuanyi is protected by his wife Gu Yuezhen, childhood friend Pei Xiangxiang, and sister Shen Leyan. On his 29th birthday, his sister is brutally murdered. His wife defends the killer, while Pei pressures him to forgive. Heartbroken, he dials a mysterious number from his grandma's music box.

name: The Eye of Wealth(Dubbed)
desc: After confronting the God of Wealth, ordinary young man Ethan gains the "Eye of Wealth," granting him the power to appraise treasures, amass riches, and uncover conspiracies. Teaming up with the aloof Harper, he battles business rivals and unravels family mysteries—ultimately transforming his life.

name: A Mother Who Forgives No One
desc: After thirty years of widowhood, Xie Changning raised her children to success, only for them to force her to sign a letter of disownment when her clan faced execution. Reborn before the tragedy, she decides to let her ungrateful children face their fate and refuses to forgive them.

name: My Loyal Demon Husband
desc: To fulfill his grandmother's wish, dog demon Wang Ye enters the city and saves CEO Wei Zhixue. They start a contract marriage. When enemies' plot endangers her life and family, Wang Ye reveals his true identity to save his pregnant wife, Wei Zhixue, and her grandfather.

name: Woke Up as Her Worst Husband
desc: College student Noah Walker wakes up in the body of a billionaire CEO's husband. Hoping to live off his wife's fortune, he discovers he's a scumbag who gambled, stole, and cheated. As his heartbroken wife files for divorce, he tears up the papers: "Don't cry, I won't leave you!"

name: Heart Speaks, True Heiress Wins
desc: Yama's daughter Yan Zhao possesses a young heiress who was framed by the evil impostor Shen Xinrou. Her family overhears her thoughts and uncovers Shen Xinrou and her father's schemes. With her family's support, she becomes a beloved heiress, gaining her in-laws' favor and her husband's love.

name: Love Is Sweet Torture
desc: She risked everything for her sister, but in Grayson’s world of chains and desire, her heart is torn—fighting his control even as her deepest longing aches to surrender.

name: My Ex Must Kneel to Me Daily
desc: Shen Xiaotang dies from overwork and transmigrates into the body of Shen Shuli, a bride poisoned on her wedding night. After witnessing her husband's adultery, she flees and is caught by a general. She signs a marriage contract with him, only to find that his son is her former husband.

name: His Princess From Nowhere
desc: In 1960s America, poor pianist Lucy Lay is sold to marry the rich and mysterious heir, Hannibal Rich. Trapped in a gilded cage, she uncovers forbidden desires and sibling obsession, particularly from Hannibal's twin, Anat. Lucy must confront the darkness and uncover the truth to survive.

name: Hear My Love Again
desc: Ariel, the stepdaughter of a wealthy family, is coerced into marrying Markus, a rising political star and California Congressman, whom she has admired since childhood. She replaces her stepsister, who escapes from her own arranged marriage to Markus. On their wedding day, Ariel becomes deaf due to the emotional shock of Markus's indifferent remarks. Three years later, during a kidnapping incident, Ariel miraculously regains her hearing, only to overhear Markus coldly dismissing her plight as a hoax. Secretly, she maintains the guise of being deaf and, using a voice-altering device, poses as a kidnapper to demand a divorce from Markus... Can their love, long buried beneath layers of silence and misunderstanding, find its voice again?

name: Fury Released From Prison
desc: Qin Feng is jailed while protecting his fiancée, Lin Wan'er, from Zhao Kai. After surviving an assassination attempt and learning martial arts, he defeats Zhao Kai, heals Zhang Sancheng's daughter, and gains Xingsheng Group. When Li Shengsan kidnaps Lin Wan'er, Qin Feng rescues her with Ji Yuan'er.

name: Genius Heiress Born to Win
desc: Moon Suyeon, a poor top student, discovers she's actually the heiress of a Seoul conglomerate—but her family favors the fake heiress and treats her coldly. Unbothered, she pursues Seoul's elite education, studies relentlessly, becomes the national top scorer, and enters a SKY League university.

name: Villainess Turned Favorite
desc: Emily becomes the villainess in a novel with three ruthless brothers. On the first day, she offends the male lead, Michael, then meets Thomas in an elevator, bows to him, and sleeps with him. Later, at a birthday banquet, Thomas appears as a feared villain and wealthy heir.

name: Targeted the Manager, Landed the Lady Boss
desc: To master mystical arts, Michael seeks love, targeting manager Sarah. But fate delivers his love letter to cold CEO Emily instead. Ready to flee in embarrassment, he realizes the ice-cold CEO might be worth chasing!

name: Cold Beauty Reborn
desc: Her parents divorced; her mother remarried a tycoon. Her greedy sister followed their mother, while she helped her father and brothers succeed—only to be betrayed and killed. Reborn on the day of the divorce, she watches her sister choose their father and realizes she has also been reincarnated.

name: True Love Waits
desc: Single mother Jones faces eviction with daughter Vicky and granddaughter Jane. Mysterious gardener Bruce helps them. As Jones and Bruce grow closer, his billionaire identity emerges. Bruce's mother Diana names Jane heir to fortune and grants assets to Jones and Vicky too. They end up together.

name: This Time, She Chose Right
desc: Fang Yan was killed by scumbag Zhou Yaozu and Li Sisi in her past life. Reborn, she rejected Zhou Yaozu and sponsored Xiao Huaichuan for competitions. Zhou Yaozu was repeatedly humiliated and fell into debt. Fang Yan countered their schemes at her birthday party and married Xiao Huaichuan happily.

name: Me and My Bad Student
desc: Top student Haley, bullied as a bookworm, becomes the tutor of the principal's mischievous son, Ethan. Though they clash, she endures his antics for her late mother's Harvard dream. But why does her heart race near him? Why does he risk everything for her? Are their feelings just annoyance?

name: Fifteen Years Blind, Invincible for Life
desc: The Jing family, the strongest in the martial world, is destroyed after being blamed for treason and losing the powerful artifact "Star Shift." Jing Tian, the only survivor, is sent to the Lin family. With the artifact in his possession, can he stay safe, or will he return stronger?

name: Ms. Doctor and Her Hidden Billionaire Husband
desc: Barney Wilde, a billionaire of the Wilde Group, disguised as 'Kian', returns to uncover the truth about the fire that nearly killed him. He crosses paths with Skye, a feisty woman betrayed by Jason, Barney's nephew. Skye's rise at the hospital uncovers shocking truths: Jason orchestrated the fire to kill Barney. As chaos escalates, Barney's ex, Kelly, arrives. She manipulates Skye and frames Barney. The truth explodes in a fiery climax, with Skye and Barney risking everything to expose the villains.

name: Chased by My Childhood Neighbor
desc: Senna lands an internship at a top firm, James Group, while living with her boyfriend and best friend. Her childhood neighbor Klaus shows up and discovers her boyfriend's affair with her best friend. Senna sees Klaus as a child, unaware he's a hunter encroaching on her life.

name: His On-Call Heiress
desc: Grace Lewis, Royalton's top socialite, is abandoned on her wedding night. Drunk and heartbroken, she mistakes elite heir Ethan Robinson for a male escort. After their night together, he blackmails her with videos, making her his on-call sidekick while asking her daily, "Divorced yet?"

name: The Scapegoat's Second Chance
desc: Sister-in-law Su Qian pushes her own child down the stairs. Li Xue calls an ambulance but is framed by her parents and husband. Her brother splits Li Xue in half. Dying, she wonders why they lied. Reborn to that day, she vows to expose the truth with her own hands.

name: Billionaire's Abused Lover
desc: He misunderstood that his wife had killed his sister and tortured his wife cruelly. Until she left him that he regretted it...

name: The Daughter They Let Die
desc: Gu Qiushi's heart is shattered in a car accident while protecting her brother. Her parents, focused solely on her brother, miss the critical chance to save her, and she dies in a corner where no one knows.

name: No More Second Best
desc: Heiress Lin Shuhe hides her identity to marry Xiao Jingheng, only to find she's just a stand-in for his crush Jiang Lin. After being hurt, she divorces him, regains her status, and meets Fu Jinnian, a CEO who secretly loves her. As Xiao Jingheng regrets it, Lin Shuhe finds happiness with Fu Jinnian.

name: I Married My Husband's Enemy
desc: Li Shiya lost her left leg saving Gu Ciyuan, but he misunderstood and tortured her. With Fu Jiuxiao's help, she fights back. Eventually, Gu Ciyuan regrets it too late. Li Shiya ends up with Fu Jiuxiao, while Gu Ciyuan spends his life alone, filled with remorse.

name: Reborn to Expose My Daughter-in-Law
desc: Wu Guixiang discovers her daughter-in-law cheating at home. When confronted, the daughter-in-law denies it and teams up with her parents against her, enraging her to death. Reborn to the day of the affair, she collects evidence secretly instead of exposing it immediately, then reveals all.

name: Making My Fake-Amnesia Wife Regret
desc: Taylor is betrayed to death by his wife Scarlett and reborn five years earlier. He discovers her amnesia is fake, meant for her first love. He divorces her, leaving empty-handed, and refuses to help when her company faces disaster. Scarlett regrets her actions and suffers the consequences.

name: Swapped Brides, Swapped Fates
desc: Sisters Chu Nian and Chu Yue have arranged marriages. Chu Nian demands the wealthy heir, humiliating her sister Chu Yue. Chu Yue marries the town contractor, who is secretly a tycoon doting on her. Chu Nian suffers mistreatment from her mother-in-law.

name: The Princess Reclaims Her Name
desc: Bi Mo is the emperor's lost daughter. But neighbor A Yao steals her identity, and she dies by the sword. Reborn, she vows to change her fate, but A Yao strikes again. Facing death, Consort Wan saves her. Bi Mo and Consort Wan investigate together, reveal the truth, and reclaim what's hers.

name: Shamed at Wedding, Came Back Stunning
desc: IT manager Gupta is thrilled to marry a wealthy heiress until she's revealed as 300-pound Aishwarya. Their marriage crumbles over her weight and a mistress. Determined, she transforms through intense weight loss. Her stunning transformation silences all who mocked her.

name: The Heiress Who Won With Brains
desc: Linda Walker, a top student from a disadvantaged province, is recognized by a wealthy capital family. Facing family schemes and a fake heiress's sabotage, she stays focused, seizes a capital residency, studies relentlessly, and earns a place at a top university, claiming her own success.

name: The Wife's Mask(Dubbed)
desc: After giving birth, Emily's newborn son was secretly swapped by Michael with Sarah's child. Emily managed to secretly save her biological son, Robert, while raising David as her own. After David graduated, Michael revealed the truth—but Emily still left her entire fortune to David. Later, at a business meeting organized by Robert, the truth was publicly exposed. Emily presented solid evidence of the crimes committed by Michael and others, sending them all to prison.

name: Champion Dad, I Am Your Lucky Girl
desc: Years ago, after being drugged and spending a night with swimming champion George, Ella was left pregnant, cast out, and raised daughter alone. Years later, fate reunites them. Unaware of each other's identities, Ella and George fall in love again, overcome obstacles, and finally unite as a family.

name: Reborn: The Legend Luna Awakening
desc: After enduring betrayal and murder at the hands of her husband and stepsister, Emma is bestowed with rebirth by the Moon Goddess. This time, she resolves not to be the pitiable pawn she once was. Her new mission is to discern her destined mate among the two Alphas standing before her.

name: My CEO, My Miracle(Dubbed)
desc: Freshly back from abroad, Luo Xin accidentally spends a night with Chen Fan, unwittingly endowing him with a mysterious power. The next day, he's shocked to discover she's the new CEO of his company—igniting a whirlwind of passion and unexpected complications.

name: Breaking Free, Building Anew
desc: Reborn, Yin Xiaoyao outsmarts her cheating husband Xiao Jin and his mistress Yuan Ya, secures her study abroad spot, divorces resolutely, and dedicates herself to national development. She returns educated, rejects his remarriage plea, and starts a new life free from the past.

name: The Last Life She Gave Him
desc: The fox demon Hu Zhazhao marries Xuan Ye to repay him, sacrificing her nine lives to make him emperor. When enemies force his choice, he shoots her, unaware that she only has nine lives and it is her last life. Grief-stricken, he refuses to bury her, clutching her body and begging her to wake.

name: All My Bully Wants for Christmas Is Me
desc: Scholarship student Mavis Wynn's first kiss is stolen by star quarterback Julian Sterling at Harper High, making her Public Enemy No. 1. After a Christmas betrayal shatters her heart, Julian saves her and claims he wants to win her heart. Is this her bully's twisted game or the real thing?

name: Taking Back My Crown
desc: After her boyfriend, Chen Zhiyuan, causes a crash that leaves her paralyzed and then vanishes, Qin Minghui sees through his cruelty. She decides to stop hiding her true identity as the wealthy heiress to reclaim everything that belongs to her.

name: The Return of the Heiress
desc: Shao Jinjin returns 20 years after being swapped at birth and discovers the evil plots of her imposter, Shao Ranran. After dying and being reborn, she uses her memories to expose her rival’s true face and seek justice for herself and her parents.

name: Forbidden Ties
desc: To pay off her stepfather’s debts, 18-year-old Reyes strikes a deal with a wealthy family—and spends seven nights with the cold Mason. Her child is taken from her, and she barely survives. Ten years later, Mason hires her as her son’s tutor. Now, she’ll rise to rewrite her fate.

name: The Eye of Wealth
desc: After confronting the God of Wealth, ordinary young man Ethan gains the "Eye of Wealth," granting him the power to appraise treasures, amass riches, and uncover conspiracies. Teaming up with the aloof Harper, he battles business rivals and unravels family mysteries—ultimately transforming his life.

name: Entangled With My Stepbrother
desc: Olivia hates her stepmother and stepbrother Noah because her father abandoned her seriously ill mother, but she becomes Noah's secretary by mistake. The rivals gradually develop an ambiguous relationship, while Olivia uncovers a shocking secret behind her family's misfortune.

name: Fated to My Billionaire Call Boy
desc: Claire wants to have a baby to give her ailing grandmother something to live for. When Claire’s cheating husband leaves her, she hires a call boy to make a baby with her. She doesn’t know the call boy is actually billionaire Dominic Bridges who is in love with her and will do anything to get her. But her scheming rival, Gina, will do anything to keep them apart.

name: Out of Prison, Into Justice
desc: Lucas Moore was wrongly jailed for seven years, tortured, and betrayed by his family. After his release, he marries Emma Smith, his childhood friend, who helps him seek revenge. With the victim's aid, the truth emerges at an auction, where Mason Moore is arrested, finally vindicating Lucas Moore.

name: Curing My Doomed Prince
desc: Modern doctor Bai Rusu transmigrates as the wife of paralyzed Prince Fu Ziheng. Learning she'll die with him, she treats him and opens a renowned pharmacy. With her medical expertise, she revives the estate and becomes Daliang's strongest couple with Fu Ziheng.

name: Believing in Love Again
desc: Zhou Ruoyu is drugged by her scumbag husband Luo Haibin and sent to billionaire Gu Jingdong's bed. Unaware she's his unforgettable love, after the night, she becomes pregnant. As Luo Haibin and her family abuse her and threaten her, Gu Jingdong rushes to her rescue after learning the truth.

name: Noble Wife, Raising Her Revenge
desc: Sophia Walker, once the marquis household matriarch, was poisoned after adopting a concubine's children. Reborn, she takes revenge—demotes the daughter originally intended as heir, arranges the eldest daughter to serve in the Prince Frost's Residence, and reclaims her power and status.

name: Healing My Mortal Wife First(Dubbed)
desc: Former Golden Immortal Mason Clark reincarnates into a dead gambler's body after crushing spirit-stone debt. He finds the loser left a gorgeous mute wife, brutalized beyond reason. Mason decides to start his mortal adventure here—first move: earn cash, craft pills, and cure his bride.

name: The Heiress Who Won With Brains(Dubbed)
desc: Linda Walker, a top student from a disadvantaged province, is recognized by a wealthy capital family. Facing family schemes and a fake heiress's sabotage, she stays focused, seizes a capital residency, studies relentlessly, and earns a place at a top university, claiming her own success.

name: Dragon's Shadow
desc: Hearing that the Dragon Divine King is arriving in Jiang City, several prominent families rush to the airport to welcome the Divine King's helicopter. To their surprise, the person stepping off the helicopter is Duan Xiao, the son-in-law who went to prison five years ago to take the fall for his wife's brother. Duan Xiao believes that his wife, Rong Jingxiao, and his father-in-law, Rong Haidong, are there to welcome him out of prison, only to be met with humiliation. Rong Jingxiao coldly tells Duan Xiao to go to her company, as she has something to discuss with him, before turning and leaving. Just as Duan Xiao prepares to follow her, Miss Wen Xueqing of the Wen family arrives in a luxury car and asks him to marry her.

name: Married to a Storm
desc: Left at the altar by Michael and branded a "bad luck star," Sarah marries Daniel seven years later and has son Ethan. When Michael returns with pregnant Daisy, falsely accusing Sarah and demanding she kneel, Daniel intervenes to resolve the crisis.

name: She Quit and Bought the Company
desc: Top saleswoman Wen Rou overhears her boss's wife's inner thoughts and learns that her achievements were stolen and that she is about to be fired. She joins a rival company, builds it into a powerhouse, and ultimately acquires her former firm, driving her former boss's wife to bankruptcy.

name: Real Heiress Back for Blood
desc: In my past life, the nanny's daughter used my card to pretend to be a heiress. She framed me for exam cheating. When my father sought to clear my name, she reported him for bribery. Our company collapsed. I died on the streets. Opening my eyes again, I'm back in my senior year.

name: Her Revenge Is Poison
desc: Poison master Jiang Mengluo discovers her husband Xiao Ce'an is a marquis heir. Xiao Ce'an is forced by his official wife Cen Yuan'er to poison her into sterility. After losing her child due to abuse, Jiang Mengluo vows to make the entire marquis household pay for their cruelty.

name: Bound to a Serpent God
desc: Su Yin dreams of the serpent god Shen Jue and wakes pregnant. Escaping abuse, she learns that her grandfather Ye Yuanshan sacrificed her and killed her parents for forbidden power. She exposes his crimes, destroys the Ye family with allies, and finds happiness with Shen Jue and their child.

name: Breathing Free, Loving Me
desc: Shen Jing, once a homemaker, discovers her husband Zhou Jingxing's affair after being kidnapped. Heartbroken, she divorces him, raises their daughter alone, and builds success selling food. Fu Sinian pursues her, Zhou Jingxing regrets, but she embraces independence and Fu Sinian's love.

name: Fishing System: Catch Everything
desc: After fishing for 100 days, Zhou Haoyun awakens his Universal Fishing System just as his gold-digging wife divorces him for the wealthy Gao Zihao. He catches the Imperial Jade Seal and a giant koi, impressing tycoon Mr. Jiang, who offers his daughter's hand and the company inheritance.

name: The Girl Who Chose the Sword(Dubbed)
desc: In the declining Dragon Kingdom, Sarah, granddaughter of the missing Martial Saint Owen, seeks refuge with the Ruiz family. Barred from learning martial arts, she secretly trains, defeats a traitor, repels foreign invaders, and inherits her grandfather's legacy to restore peace.

name: The Blessed Pregnancy
desc: A prophecy foretells one of two women will bear a blessed child, determining the next crown prince. After rebirth, Prince He Yanxiu marries Meng Qingyi while Su Jinshi weds Prince He Yuan. Fraud and poisoning fail as Su Jinshi bears true boy–girl twins, exposing the conspiracy.

name: Revenge on my ex-husband
desc: After the divorce, I married my ex-husband's cousin.

name: Factory Worker, Secret Heiress
desc: After 7 years at an electronics factory, Sophia Walker asks her boyfriend Noah Wright to meet her parents, but he refuses while favoring intern Emma Miller. She breaks up with him and quits. Noah later discovers she's a billionaire's daughter who married a wealthy younger man.

name: The Housewife's Rebellion
desc: Housewife Zhang Lianying catches her husband cheating and decides to divorce, pursue her career, and live life on her own terms. Her husband and son, used to her support, can't function without her and beg her to return. But the awakened Zhang Lianying no longer cares.

name: Super Dad, Super Family(Dubbed)
desc: Xu Lai is taken to another world by The Nine Dragon Haul. After cultivation, he returns to find his wife abandoned by family and his daughter abused. He feeds them rare medicines for protection—they gain superpowers he didn't know existed, becoming superhumans and causing hilarious chaos.

name: Unstoppable Kid: Dad's Savior
desc: Dingdang, an orphan cursed bringing loneliness, mastering divination and aura-reading. Her blunt honesty offends all. She is tricked to find her father Qin Sihan, who denies her due to his barren curse. When his family schemes, she defends him. They break their curses, and defeat villains.

name: No Heart, No Mercy
desc: Jiang Yubai has two hearts, but his family treats him as an organ bank for his sick brother. After being betrayed by his wife Gu Nuan and family, he is forced to donate his last heart and dies. Returning as Kang Huanzhi, Jiang Yubai exposes their hypocrisy and seeks justice for himself.

name: The Rebellious Princess Consort
desc: Courtesan Jiang Qiuye only wants freedom and wealth, but the disgraced prince Lu Bingzhao, whose five wives have died, forces her to marry him. Thrust into imperial power struggles, she vows to take his wealth while denying any feelings as they battle and gradually fall for each other.

name: Never Turning Back
desc: Kong Yan's husband Zhang Qiang steals her father's house and saddles her with debt. After being struck by lightning, she's reborn. This time, she transfers the debt to him, saves General Manager Guo Qiming, exposes Zhang Qiang and Shen Fang's affair, and starts anew with Guo Qiming's help.

name: Awakening in Spring
desc: Xu Yinyin was swapped at birth, going from the esteemed daughter of the Marquis' family to the daughter of a pig slaughterer. After the truth was discovered, she was sent back to the Marquis' family, only to be framed by her former foster parents, who ruined her reputation and caused her downfall. Eventually, the false daughter framed her again, breaking both of her legs and throwing her into a mass grave. She is reborn on the eve of being returned to the Marquis' family, marking both the beginning of her past nightmare and the start of her revenge in this life...

name: Reborn to End My Marriage
desc: Shu Yan, scorned by her husband Meng's family for infertility, dies in an accident where they save his mistress Liu Jiaojiao instead. Reborn, she divorces and exposes their affair at their wedding. As CEO of Chifeng Group, she defeats the Meng family's schemes and finds love with Fu Chen.

name: Never a Doormat, Always the Master(Dubbed)
desc: Thirteen years ago, orphan Noah Lee was taken away by an immortal. Now back, he faces his grandfather's arranged marriage. Refusing to be a son-in-law, he demands to cancel it—or let them take his surname. Adapted from Master Returns: Never a Son-in-law.

name: Mafia Lover
desc: Ace, a ruthless mob boss ruling London's underworld, is ambushed by his rival Jack. A young stranger, Max, steps in to save him. Impressed, Ace brings Max into his inner circle, growing to trust him and making him his personal bodyguard.

name: Heiress with the Inner Voice Hack
desc: The true heiress is killed by her fake sister and her father. Sophia wakes up inside the novel on the day the true heiress returns home, and her family can hear her thoughts. With this power, she exposes their schemes, helps her kin fight back, and wins both justice and love.

name: Accidentally Inherited One Trillion
desc: This drama follows Xiao Yang, a ride-hailing driver who, after being humiliated and beaten at work, almost loses his job. However, the secretary of Shengqiang Group, the largest company in Jiang Province, visits him with news that he is set to inherit a trillion-dollar fortune. Initially skeptical, Xiao Yang plans to refuse the inheritance, but his mother's illness and financial struggles prompt him to reconsider. He learns that the president of Shengqiang Group, Xiao, is his distant relative, who left him the fortune on his deathbed, but with many conditions. To inherit it, Xiao Yang must complete several trials. The first is to marry and have a child to continue the family line. When he plans to propose to his girlfriend, Su Manyu, he discovers she is with Yang Shimei, the son of Yang Ming, and mocks him for having nothing. After being beaten by Yang Shimei's bodyguard, Xiao Yang gains the ability to hear people's inner thoughts.

name: The Dragon King's Command Ⅲ
desc: Guided by a master,  Michael becomes the lord of the Dragon's Palace, but is falsely accused and imprisoned. In jail, he seizes an opportunity, wins over the inmates, tasked with mediating the conflict between the northern and southern martial arts worlds.

name: The Bride Swap That Backfired
desc: Fu Mingyan and his cousin are both reborn on their wedding night. In their past lives, the cousin married a rich beauty, while Fu Mingyan married the village chief's daughter. After being reborn, the cousin swaps their brides, but Fu Mingyan's life improves, and the cousin regrets his actions.

name: Two Women, One Delivery Guy(Dubbed)
desc: Delivery guy Chen Keyuan catches a woman stealing files, saving Qingyun Group. Boss Jiang Xueying forces him to fake-date her. His suitor, Black Widow, won't let anyone steal her delivery boy. Chen Keyuan is caught between two women. The savage love chase begins!

name: Loving You in Secret Too
desc: Meng Shiyi has secretly loved He Xilou for years, but a misunderstanding made her think he loved someone else, so she never confessed. When he sees her with another man, jealousy drives him wild. Cornering her, he growls, "Do you like me—or him?"

name: The Retired Hero Strikes
desc: Retired martial arts leader Duan Ye runs a massage shop with his daughter Shishi. He saves fleeing Princess Yu Ruyi and defeats her enemy Zhu San but refuses to help her reclaim her throne. Zhu San kidnaps Shishi in revenge. Duan Ye comes out of retirement, rescues his daughter, and defeats Zhu San.

name: After Divorce, She Stuns Them All
desc: Heiress Su Tao was kidnapped as a child and saved by Lu Hanchuan. She marries CEO Lu Hanchuan to repay him, but he mistakes another woman for his childhood sweetheart and forces Su Tao to divorce him. After reclaiming her identity, she confronts her ex-husband's family.

name: The Wife He Tried to Kill
desc: Reborn after a fatal dog attack, Zhen Shan discovers her husband, Fu Xinren, orchestrated her death for her inheritance and is having an affair with their housekeeper. She gathers evidence, exposes his betrayal and fraud, saves her father's company, and brings them to justice.

name: Married in a Flash, His Beloved
desc: Adopted daughter Emily endures mistreatment in the Getty family. One act of protection from Thomas kept her by his side for years—until he watched others humiliate her at their engagement. She gives up and marries Lyle that night. His care heals her, revealing his ten-year secret love.

name: Forced to Raise the Regent's Child
desc: Sophia's father seemed perfect. At her death, she learned the truth: he had a secret family. Her half-sister sold her to traffickers, and killed her grandfather. Reborn five years earlier, she'll make them pay. But who's this child clinging to her leg, calling her "mother"? Does the Regent know?

name: The Young Master's Forbidden Butler
desc: Simon returns to the powerful family where his grandfather once served, driven by a relentless thirst for vengeance over his parents' tragic deaths. As the new butler, he skillfully sows discord between the master and his wife, seduces the young heir, Allen, and methodically eliminates every enemy in his path. But just as his revenge reaches its climax, a shocking truth is revealed—Simon is the master's biological son, the rightful heir to the empire. Yet what he never expected was to truly fall for Allen. Caught in a web of love and hatred, the two are torn apart by an unrelenting cycle of vengeance, unable to escape the fate that binds them.

name: The Heiress Claimed Her Crown
desc: Heiress Duan Linxi hides her background to help fiancé Song Xu's company, but he prefers assistant He Xuefei. She reveals her true background, crashes their stock, and exposes He Xuefei's scandal. Song Xu regrets too late. Linxi acquires the company and finds true love.

name: After My Genius Daughter Falls
desc: After ten years with Jiang Wang, Shen Yike discovers his infidelity and betrayal of their daughter, Jiang Meng. Decisive, Shen Yike divorces him and reclaims her company. She casts Jiang Wang out, securing a flourishing life for herself and her daughter.

name: Sight Beyond Sight
desc: Huang Yong, a rural youth, discovers his wife’s betrayal. After a brutal fight, he gains the ability to see through objects and learns ancient medical skills. He uses these powers to seek revenge and fight injustice.

name: Out of Prison, Hell to Pay
desc: Fifteen years ago, Long Zhen fought the Dragon City underworld alone to protect his friends, becoming a legendary figure. Fifteen years later, after his release, his wife and daughter face ruthless enemies. The king returns, and the martial world trembles once again!

name: Married My Groom's Brother
desc: Prime Minister Shen Huaizhi and his brother's fiancée Qianqian are arranged to marry after they believed his brother was dead. When his brother returns, their relationship faces trials. His brother schemes to expose their "affair" for power, but fails. Shen Huaizhi and Qianqian end up together.

name: The Wife's Revenge
desc: Emily and Daniel meet in college. Despite their different backgrounds, Emily falls for Daniel's humble ambition. After marriage, she undergoes six rounds of IVF for the infertile Daniel, finally conceiving twins. A car accident sends Emily Wilson to the ER, but Daniel pays zero attention to her

name: From General to Radiant Heiress(Dubbed)
desc: Brave and skilled General Emily Brown unexpectedly time-travels into the body of the neglected true daughter of the wealthy Jones family. Faced with mockery from the fake heiress Sarah Jones and scorn from the staff, she fights back with wit and courage to reclaim what's hers.

name: Power Gained Under Pressure
desc: Reborn Ye Lingfeng activates his anti-pressure system, gaining skills to start a business and become top scholar. After entering the top university, he defeats his rivals, gains more skills, encounters Shu Meng, Leng Luoyu, and Tang Xueer, and navigates complex feelings among them.

name: I Predict the Future, I Win
desc: His hard work was stolen by his boss, and his snobbish ex-wife left him. However, he gains a phone that predicts the future. Using this foresight, he turns his failing life around, acquiring luxury cars, beautiful women, and trillions in wealth.

name: Reborn: The Heir's Revenge
desc: Fan Yucheng, the youngest grandson of the Ji conglomerate, is brutally killed after being framed. Reborn, he meticulously takes revenge on everyone, surrounded by beauties, rising to the top. The Ji family ultimately suffers the consequences of their own flaws under his schemes.

name: Rewrite the Truth
desc: Top student Lin Xia is reborn. To foil a cheating frame-up by Lin Mufeng and Feng Yanran, she hands in a blank paper to prove her innocence. Using her reserved admission to shine, she defies Feng Yanran's tycoon father’s power and uncovers the mystery of her true birth.

name: Desperate Housewife's Stunning Comeback
desc: The heroine hides her wealthy identity when she marries and has children, but unexpectedly catches her husband cheating. Both her husband and his mistress scorn her true status and force her to divorce and leave. A successful businessman—who is also her husband's investor—happens to witness this injustice and steps in to help. Instantly falling for her, he rescues her from hardship and, pressured by his family to marry, confesses his love on the spot. She agrees, and they begin a mature romance. When she reveals her fortune, he insists he loves her for who she is, not her status. Despite ongoing suspicion and disdain from her ex-husband, his mistress, and her husband's daughter, the man's repeated acts of heroism deepen her love. In the end, even his two daughters come to accept her, and the couple wins everyone's heartfelt blessing.

name: Marrying the Throne
desc: Chu Nange helped a scumbag seize the throne, only to be betrayed and killed. Dying, she realized Gu Jinghang, whom she used and humiliated, truly loved her. Reborn, she's determined to help the scorned outcast claim the throne, offering the empire to repay his devotion.

name: Mistaken for a Weakling
desc: In his past life, Li Zhou gave his research to his biological father's company, making the Wang family a pharmaceutical giant. His devotion earned only contempt. Killed in a lab explosion caused by his adoptive brother Wang Yan, Li Zhou is reborn and vows fierce revenge.

name: Unforgivable Betrayal
desc: In my past life, my husband cheated with my best friend, staged his death, stole my fortune and a kidney, and left me bankrupt. I scavenged for ten years. This life, I'll turn their plot on them and make them pay.

name: The Emperor Lost to Her
desc: Xu Wanning, a marquis's daughter and general's wife, was killed by her sister Xu Wanyu and General Yan Yuanzheng. Reborn, she seduces the Emperor as a tool for revenge. But she miscalculates—the Emperor falls deeper than expected and vows to make her his Empress at any cost!

name: Urban System Hero
desc: A ride-hailing driver, humiliated by clients, nearly drives off in despair—until he unexpectedly awakens a system. Guided by it, he rises from rock bottom to wealth and power, crushing crime and climbing to the peak of life.

name: No Way Back to Us(Dubbed)
desc: Emily gave up her design career for Daniel, whose family demands a child for his inheritance. After a drunken one-night stand with Olivia, who gets pregnant, Daniel plans a fake divorce to keep the baby and reunite later. Hurt, Emily breaks ties and immigrates.

name: Under One Roof, Double Love Story(Dubbed)
desc: Fleeing her sister's abuser, Charlotte Wright meets mercenary Noah Moore. After a one-night stand leaves her pregnant, he proposes marriage. As they live together, she wins his heart, while Noah's brother falls for Charlotte's sister. Through trials and danger, both couples find happiness.

name: My Heimlich Shocks All
desc: Janitor Wang Ming reports Dr. Wu for harassing his girlfriend, nurse Fang Wei—but she betrays him. Fired and humiliated, he activates a system making basic medical skills seem miraculous. He saves the Cheng heiresses, crushes Wu in a contest, and defeats the "Immortal Doctor" to become a legend.

name: Back to 1990 With a Smartphone
desc: Liu Shu, an honest and weak rural outcast, is abandoned by his wife Zhao Xiaoping in old age. She and Wang Erhu bury him alive. Dying, he learns his son isn't his and that his true savior is Xiao Fang. He's reborn on his wedding day with a smartphone, and he exposes them to turn his life around.

name: Cute Face, Savage Payback
desc: In her past life, Sophia's family was destroyed by her adopted brother and the nanny's family. She died in sorrow. Reborn at age three with her memories, she's cute on the outside but ruthless inside, tearing down schemers and protecting her mother and fortune this time.

name: Taxi Driver Turned King
desc: Taxi driver Lin Fan marries into the Song family after Patriarch Song foresees his destiny. Humiliated by the family, especially his wife Song Yan, he awakens as the Guide King of the Three Realms. He saves Patriarch Su Liancheng, earns Su Menghan's favor, and faces threats from Lu Chenxiao.

name: Oops, Not Again: 2002 Rewind
desc: Elite bachelor Henry is reborn in 2002, on the day he is heading to register at university. Using foresight, he builds the "Rocket 101" delivery company to capture the e-commerce boom. Yet he's torn between choosing Mia or his first love Sophia.

name: Reborn Heiress Takes Them Down
desc: Betrayed by her husband Shen Hao and her sister in her past life, heiress Lin Youyou watches CEO Chen Zeguang die saving her. Reborn, she reclaims her family's company and wins Chen Zeguang's heart. When her enemies kidnap her, he rescues her and sends them to prison for life.

name: From Today, I'm the Richest
desc: Zhang Chao struggles with debt as a delivery driver, despised for his poverty. Delivering to a wealthy gathering, he's mocked and pushed down, injuring his leg and losing his job. At his lowest, he encounters a life-changing opportunity.

name: She Took Back Everything
desc: Huangfu Tianyue left her wealthy family as Li Mengyao to marry Xu Lingchen but suffered betrayal. Huo Junlin helped her restore identity and seek revenge. She exposed Fang Yunrou and Xu Lingchen's scandals, bankrupting Xu's company. She reclaimed her son, accepted Huo Junlin, and lived happily.

name: Fallen Immortal's Love Misadventures
desc: Celestial koi Lin Fan must suffer ten heartbreaks to return to heaven. He pursues CEO Su Yue, streamer Su Keke, and singer Jiang Zihan, hoping to get dumped, but all fall for him. His failed mission earns him 100 years on Earth facing their relentless pursuit.

name: Remarried to the Warlord
desc: Bai Xiaofan expects a quiet life—until one night, while picking up her husband, she catches the eye of Sheng Yan, the most powerful man at the table. Step by step, he claims her heart. Drawn into his tenderness, Bai Xiaofan willingly becomes his cherished captive.

name: Seventh Year Loving My Childhood Friend
desc: Cheng Xia loved her childhood friend Chen Shechuan for years, but he rejected her while he was with his girlfriend Jiang Yining. She moved on with Xu Jingxiao, who pursued her and supported her writing dreams. Chen Shechuan interfered, then vanished as their relationship deepened.

name: The Stand-In Passion
desc: Gu Sui becomes a wealthy businessman's mistress, knowing she's just a stand-in for Shang Jin's first love. After repeated disappointments, she leaves. When he finds her, she coldly says, "I don't want you anymore. You're no longer like him." He realizes he's the substitute.

name: Dumped a Jerk, Got a Billionaire
desc: After five years as a housewife used as a free tool, Su Runuan divorces and strikes a deal with billionaire CEO Qin: he helps her get revenge, she poses as his fiancée. Their banter sparks unexpected romance. Facing her past and elite society's challenges, can she become a true wealthy wife?

name: From Bankruptcy to Rival's Secretary
desc: To pay off a 60 million dollar debt, Jason Collins has no choice but to become David Graham's secretary. But to everyone's surprise, the two quickly become the center of office gossip...

name: Lucky Heiress Arrives
desc: Abused by her stepmother Zhou Lin, Shen Suisui is kicked out. She saves patriarch Lu Qingming, who adopts her into his elite family. When Zhou Lin arrives to marry his third son Lu Ziyue, she tries bullying Shen Suisui—only to find her seated as the family elder.

name: All Reborn, True Heiress Wins
desc: In her past life, Sophia Mitchell severed the phoenix vein to propel her three brothers to power's peak. Yet they brutally murdered her to protect their adopted sister Emma. Reborn, she discovers her brothers also returned. She cuts ties, seeks revenge, and makes them reap their consequences.

name: Revenge Began at Her Wedding
desc: Reborn on her wedding day, Harper refuses to marry Lucas, who—as the Young Lord of the Vesper Marquisate—humiliated her in her past life. Seeking vengeance, she forms an alliance with Ethan, an imperial prince. Together, they bring down his household and claim the happiness they were denied.

name: Kidnapping the Regent's Heart
desc: Ling Zhan, the bandit chief, seizes the regent's young son to claim treasure. The regent, seeing her true face, withdraws his troops. Suffering from amnesia, she is confused as he invades the stronghold, pursuing her relentlessly. Later, Ling Zhan discovers his mansion is filled with her portraits.

name: The Fake Heiress Returns Fiercely
desc: Su Wanwan, deemed a jinx by the Su family, was framed by the true heiress, Su Shan, and died unjustly. Reborn ten years earlier, she meets billionaire CEO Lin Haoran, who helps her expose Su Shan's crimes, uncover her true identity, clear her biological parents' names, and find happiness.

name: Real Heiress Back for Blood(Dubbed)
desc: In my past life, the nanny's daughter used my card to pretend to be a heiress. She framed me for exam cheating. When my father sought to clear my name, she reported him for bribery. Our company collapsed. I died on the streets. Opening my eyes again, I'm back in my senior year.

name: Escape the Mudslide Trap
desc: Musician Shen Zhong was framed by his adopted brother Shen Zhe and fiancée Liu Ruyan, trapped in a mudslide, and misjudged by his sisters Shen Nanfei and Shen Ling. Reborn, he survives, exposes Shen Zhe with CEO Lin Zhiwei's help, leaves his sisters regretful, and goes to study abroad.

name: Trapped as a Housewife
desc: Housewife Gu Qingcheng entrusts her family business to her husband Wang Kejie. Naively comfortable, she's betrayed and murdered by Wang Kejie and her friend Ni Na for her wealth. Dying, she regrets possessing knowledge yet contributing nothing, owning assets yet avoiding all responsibility.

name: Village Girl Takes Charge
desc: The fake heiress is bullied by the Lin family and kicked out when the real heiress returns. She returns to her biological parents in the village. Her adoptive family expects her to be tortured, but her timid biological family rejoices—they finally have a commanding leader.

name: Betrayed, Then Spoiled by Four Brothers
desc: Lin Xiya hides her heiress identity to marry the scumbag Gu Chen, disfiguring herself to save him. But she's abandoned when he pursues her cousin, Lin Yue. She returns to the Fu family, and his brothers protect her. After Lin Yue is abandoned by Gu Chen, Lin Xiya teams up with her to bankrupt him.

name: Love Through the Mist(Dubbed)
desc: Scarlett Nelson (Sophia Walker) brings her daughter to the hospital and meets her ex-boyfriend Ethan Mitchell. Forced into a secret romance years ago, she left after bearing twins, keeping only her daughter. Seven years later, Ethan recognizes her and pursues her, and they finally reunite.

name: Stop Clinging, Dear Husband
desc: Shen Mian discovered she was married when forced into another marriage and insisted on divorce. Her husband Gu Beixiao, who secretly loved her for ten years, refused. He used his perfect housekeeping skills to win her over and proposed having a child to test his parenting abilities.

name: Sister's Final Testimony(Dubbed)
desc: At 18, Shen Xia lost her parents to powerful enemies. To protect her siblings, she hid the truth and sent them away, enduring 30 years as a despised outcast. Now, her successful siblings hold a live trial against her using brainwave tech, only to uncover the painful truth behind her sacrifice.

name: Mistakenly Wed, Perfectly Matched
desc: Victoria Smith, daughter of a noble household, suffers under her stepmother. Self-made general Isaac Martin rose from humble roots. Though both were engaged to others, they accidentally marry on the wedding day. A mismatched pair to everyone else, they slowly fall deeply in love.

name: Never Mess With a Woman
desc: Jiang Ping discovers signs of her husband's infidelity and tries to catch him, but each attempt is thwarted by accidents. Unbeknownst to her, a woman orchestrates every move. Even her colleague secretly works for her adversary, while her husband bears burdens he cannot reveal.

name: My Mythical Babies, Our Cupids
desc: Sophia is betrayed and thrown into the sea, but ancient dragon Alexander saves her. She has five talented children; four years later, they reunite. The kids try to test him, and he protects her from work attacks.

name: Marry My Husband Please
desc: Emma marries crush but suffers cold marriage。Sister-in-law frames her for pushing, she divorces heartbroken。Inherits billions, discovers true love was never her husband。Wrong love unveiled, new life begins

name: Sweet Bite of the Zombie King
desc: When zombies attack, Lily is abandoned by her classmates. The Zombie King grabs her, but instead of killing her, he wipes her face and hands clean. A strange bond forms between the timid girl and the possessive Zombie King. He shields her innocence with his fangs, while she melts his frozen heart.

name: My Beggar Wife Is a Legend(Dubbed)
desc: Billionaire Clara, founder of Avenir Group, disguises herself as a beggar to find genuine kindness. Arthur gives her money twice. She offers him one million, but he thinks it’s fake. When his mom demands he bring a girlfriend home, he hires Clara for forty dollars a day. She accepts, amused.

name: Frozen Brother, Regretful Sisters
desc: Orphan Mason enjoys ten happy years with the Walker family until biological son David returns and frames him. Heartbroken, Mason joins a 30-year time capsule experiment. After he leaves, his sisters find the truth. When he awakens, he chooses a new life, leaving his regretful family behind.

name: Shelter in the Mafia
desc: Tasha, betrayed by her husband and his mistress, lost her company and ended up on the streets. A stranger, Ken, a taxi driver, offered her a helping hand. Despite their initial separation, Ken kept reappearing in Tasha's life, leading her into a romantic entanglement. Little did she know, Ken was the son of a mafia boss, on a quest to find a figure from his past.

name: When Her Heart Ran Dry
desc: Craving love, Mia has long been treated as her adopted sister’s “walking blood bank.” When she learns that even her caring fiancé only loved her for her sister’s sake, she finally walks away—leaving her family and fiancé drowning in regret.

name: Debts Owed to the Serpent
desc: Ignoring his daughter Daya's pleas and a fairy's warning, Lao Zhangtou kills a guardian snake and her mate, then steals eggs from the Snake King's tomb. Strange events plague their home, repeatedly endangering Daya as supernatural retribution unfolds.

name: This Time, She Comes Out on Top
desc: Isabella Wright is reborn forty years prior, determined to escape tragedy. She rejects her husband Logan's manipulation, exposes the Johnson family's fertility fraud to her director, and transfers away. Logan Johnson loses his license, and his family collapses. Isabella finds love and a new life.

name: Too Lazy for Palace Drama
desc: Su Xing divines on her first palace day that staying low-key brings success. She eats, sleeps, and avoids harem conflicts. But after she helps Concubine Liu find her cat, her peace shatters. Determined to remain carefree, she navigates schemes and unexpectedly brings harmony to the palace.

name: Married My Twin Sister's Rich Fiance
desc: Leah accidentally killed ex-boyfriend John in self-defense, sentenced for manslaughter. Twin sister Lena bails her out. Lena's engaged to billionaire Cedric Williams, Leah's ex. Cedric needs baby for dying mother's wish, but Lena's infertile. Father Joseph uses unwanted Leah as solution.

name: Summoning My Empire
desc: After being humiliated by his ex-girlfriend and a rich heir, Su Chen gained a Summoning System. He summoned warriors to work, earned millions, and then deployed delivery workers citywide. Joined by CEO Leng Qingqiu and Empress Feng Wu, he amassed wealth and built an empire to crush his enemies.

name: Reborn to Crush My Brothers
desc: In her past life, true heiress Ye Qing was framed by the fake heiress and her three brothers, poisoned, and forced into a marriage with a corpse. Reborn, she uses her knowledge to send them to prison, rises to the top, and becomes chairwoman of Lin Group, wielding ultimate power.

name: Pregnant, Married to a Useless Prince
desc: The General's daughter, Luo Yuyan, pregnant but unsure of her child's father, has prophetic dreams of disasters. To escape fate, she marries "worthless" Prince Lin Feibai, who keeps saving her and revealing his hidden power, making her question if her dreams are real or his script.

name: Number One Fierce Soldier
desc: Elite soldier Lucas Clabe becomes CEO Sophia Lee's bodyguard. Using his skills and wit, he shields her from danger as they uncover a vast conspiracy. Together, they dismantle villains and ruthless rivals. Based on the hit novel "No.1 Soldier".

name: The Girl Who Tamed Her Dad
desc: After escaping the live burial by her birth parents Lu Wenqiang and Gu Jiao, Lu Qiaoqiao exposes their plot and chooses her playboy uncle Lu Yiting as her new father. She reforms him through force and wit, defeats her enemies, reveals her hidden identities, and builds a true bond with him.

name: Pampered in My Second Life
desc: In her past life, Sophia Walker, heiress of the Walker Group, was tortured to death by her four foster brothers and beneficiary Emma Clark. Reborn, she cuts ties and marries top officer Ethan Mitchell, who proposes 99 times to win her heart. The brothers realize her value too late.

name: Goodbye Husband, Don't Regret When I'm Gone
desc: After mafia boss Royce brings home his mistress, Alyssa, and their illegitimate son, Oliver, his wife Daisy decides to fake her own death. Consumed by regret, Royce tries to win his wife back, but little does he know she has already stepped into a new life.

name: From Ruin to Tycoon's Bride
desc: To favor his illegitimate daughter, Xie Mian's father frames her as a fraud. After being tortured, Xie Mian encounters the tycoon Jin Hanchuan and asks for his help. Carrying his child, she is pampered by his wealthy family while taking revenge on her enemies.

name: Accidentally Married a Sleeping Beauty
desc: To pay for his parents' medical bills, Ethan Miller agrees to a high-stakes marriage. Although he thought his spouse, Sophia Walker, was nearly forty, she turns out to be a beautiful young woman. Through Ethan‘s care, she recovers, tests his sincerity, and leaves the hospital.
